title: Purair® CAGEX Ductless Fume Hood for Animal Research Laboratories
meta_title: Purair CAGEX Ductless Fume Hood | Protect Users and Environment in Animal Research
meta_description: The Purair CAGEX ductless fume hood is engineered to protect users and the environment from animal dander and bedding particulates in animal research labs.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, animal research, laboratory safety, particulate containment, odor control
short_description: Engineered to meet the needs of the animal research laboratory, the Purair® CAGEX is designed to protect the user and the environment from animal dander or bedding material particulates generated on the work surface. The CAGEX incorporates carbon filters to absorb odor while optional HEPA filtration contains harmful particulates generated during cage changing and waste disposal operations.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair CAGEX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the animal research industry. Key features include a high-efficiency EC blower, energy-saving LED lighting, filter blockage alarm, improved filter clamping to eliminate bypass leakage, easy-to-change filters, and a mounted waste container for rapid waste disposal within the work zone. The durable, chemically resistant cabinet frame and easy-to-clean work surfaces make the CAGEX ideal for animal cage cleaning, bedding changes, and waste disposal operations. The hinged front sash facilitates easy opening and closing, while the optional mobile cart offers ergonomic use and maximum flexibility. The CAGEX construction complies with current technical and safety regulations.
seo_content: The Purair CAGEX ductless fume hood is specifically engineered to provide a safe, controlled work environment for a wide range of animal research applications. With its advanced filtration technology, the CAGEX effectively captures and contains animal dander, bedding particulates, and other hazardous materials generated during routine cage cleaning, bedding changes, and waste disposal. This helps protect both the user and the surrounding environment from exposure to these potentially harmful contaminants. The CAGEX's durable, chemically resistant construction, easy-to-clean work surfaces, and user-friendly design make it an ideal solution for animal research laboratories seeking to enhance safety and compliance.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.

Filtration & Controls.Filter Types: GP Plus!, ACI Plus!/SUL, ACR, ACM, AMM, FOR, HEPA/ULPA
